title: Additional modelled travel in Surabaya

title: Map discovery is not equivalent to a qualified workshop inventory
caption: Logarithmic y-axis. Counts cover expanded study windows. Deterministic name/category/confidence/duplicate filters remove many records but do not verify ownership, Toyota fitment or job capability. Exact rules and each exclusion reason are retained in provider_inventory.csv.
sources: Overture Maps Places release 2026-10-21.0; this study's documented candidate filters.

title: Travel-time access by channel
caption: All-routed scenario. Cumulative shares use all sampled grid origins as the denominator. Missing or unreachable origins do not become successful access. Curves beyond 60 minutes are outside the display. These grid shares are not population, vehicle-owner or customer shares.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs.

title: Twenty-minute modelled access
caption: All-routed scenario. The threshold is an analytical sensitivity setting, not a validated willingness-to-travel limit. Candidate garages do not have verified Toyota/job equivalence. Finite destination inventory and baseline routing apply.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs.

title: Sensitivity to large endpoint snapping
caption: The 250 m screen is an analyst-defined coordinate/routing sensitivity, not a diagnosis of wrong coordinates. Its paired-origin denominator may change across scenarios; inspect the accompanying tables.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs.

title: Origin-level travel burdens are uneven within markets
caption: All-routed scenario. Boxes show medians and interquartile ranges of paired grid-origin time differences; whiskers use 1.5 IQR. Points are grid calculations, not independent customers or evidence of switching.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs.

title: Administrative-style clipping can hide relevant destinations
caption: Nearest means fastest among listed, routable destinations in the expanded window. Outside refers to the origin-study rectangle, not a city boundary. The expanded window is still finite; this diagnostic does not prove all relevant providers are captured.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs.

title: Road snapping is a measurable source of uncertainty
caption: Large snapping can reflect inaccessible origin points, network gaps or coordinate placement. It is not automatically source error. The routing tables retain source and destination displacement separately.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs.

title: Documented network offerings sharpen the oil-service comparison
caption: Official directory coordinates for Auto2000, OtoXpert and Shop & Drive. Network-level oil/filter advertising provides a stronger service lead than a generic map tag, but Toyota fitment, exact parts, price and current slots remain unconfirmed. These are locations, not exclusive or independent ownership classes. Dashed rectangles are the origin windows; some margin destinations are outside the display.
sources: Official Auto2000, OtoXpert and Shop & Drive directories retrieved 14 Nov 2026; network service evidence in sources register.

title: Modelled access to collected advertised oil-service channels
caption: All-routed scenario. The specific-service comparator uses the collected official network/local advertised oil-service destinations, not all Overture candidates. It is a finite public-source inventory, not all equivalent workshops. Exact Toyota model/year fitment, parts availability, current price and appointment capacity remain unconfirmed. Grid shares are not customer shares; these are baseline routing times.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs. Shop & Drive official directory and additional advertised-provider evidence in supplemental routing inputs.

title: Focal branch leave-one-out access sensitivity
caption: Screened scenario, both endpoints snap ≤250 m. Three branches per market selected by nearest grid-origin count, with the stated tie-break rule in focal12_branches.csv. Left counts are geographic assignment, not workloads or customers. Right shows the median extra modelled travel only among origins affected by omitting that branch; n is the affected-origin count. Omission is a computational sensitivity, not a closure recommendation or economic estimate.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs.

title: Candidate-definition uncertainty changes the travel-burden estimate
caption: All-routed scenarios using the same 81 origins per market and frozen OD matrix. Provider confidence is an upstream source score, not audited capability. Explicit car-name selection is a lexical screen, not verified Toyota fitment or job equivalence. Compare magnitude changes rather than treating any candidate rule as ground truth. Main screened maps use a separate ≤250 m snapping rule.
sources: Official Auto2000/OtoXpert directories collected 14 Nov 2026; Overture Places 2026-10-21.0; OSRM retrieval in packaged logs. Derived candidate_sensitivity_summary.csv.
